author: singular99
quote:
I have never played a more didactic game in my life. Incredibly preachy. The story is simply there to annoy you if you are in any way a real adult who understands what healthy relationships look like.

I don’t understand how even for a GTA game, the plot can be this tone deaf. You’re telling me that the solution to get your child back from child protective services is to do crime? You really couldn’t make this up if you tried. The mental gymnastics the player needs to do to rationalize this plot is too much even for me.

Then we can dock points for bugs, glitches, frame rate being sub 30. Missions being bland. The heat system is so easy you might as well have called this a visual novel and not a shooter. Heat 3/4 is just “hide in bush” simulator.

Then you get into issues with the simulation. Sorry, why is everything so needlessly complex for a game that is supposed to deliver fun and entertainment. The realism isn’t even maxed out, it’s passed that. To the point where it’s so realistic it isn’t. Everything gets in your way. 

There’s plenty of “oh that’s funny” moments but none of them hit even remotely as hard as the trio from GTA5, let alone the cast from 3/4. 

And then…all the silly censorship. Excuse me sir this is GTA.

After 20 hours I had to just uninstall. I couldn’t keep going. It felt like a literal chore to play.
